name: flow-batch-runner
description: Extensión de Chrome que automatiza Google Flow para producir Shorts en lote (MUNDO FUT / The Odd Ledger).

scripts.check: node --check extension/shared.js && node --check extension/content.js && node --check extension/popup.js && node --check extension/background.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('extension/manifest.json','utf8')); console.log('manifest OK')"
